note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry; the sources field names where each fact was checked. PowerPyx and Push Square agree on the counts used here (55 trophies, 18 meditation spots, 397 stunts, 42 shooting-range challenges, 14 drone races, 18 card sets, 80 challenges, 8 garages, 9 gangs, 8 bank vaults). They disagree on total time: PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours to platinum, Push Square 300 or more, so this guide says 200-300 hours. Round 2 adds guide_short: a 1-2 sentence condensed guide per trophy for the compact detail pane; the full guide stays in guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the three roadmap stages in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and this pops at the end. Expect the whole hunt to take roughly 200-300 hours; the two guides we checked disagree on the exact figure, PowerPyx saying about 200 and Push Square 300 or more.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and the trophy unlocks as part of the story. It cannot be missed: every playthrough starts here. Just follow the mission prompts and enjoy the introduction to Leonida.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and the trophy unlocks as part of the story. It cannot be missed: every playthrough starts here. Just follow the mission prompts and enjoy the introduction to Leonida.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks when the chapter closes. It is automatic story progress, so it cannot be missed. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay — that protects the one missable meditation in Chapter 1, not this trophy.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks when the chapter closes. It is automatic story progress, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2's main missions and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 2 is also where you first get to switch between Jason and Lucia freely, which opens up the partner trophies later.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete Chapter 2's main missions and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 2 is also where you first get to switch between Jason and Lucia freely, which opens up the partner trophies later.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3's main missions to the end; the trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter closes. Nothing here can be missed. Several systems that later trophies need — the Key Cloner, jewelry robberies, Randy's wish list — are introduced during this chapter, so do the story missions as they appear.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Play through Chapter 3's main missions to the end; the trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter closes. Nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's main missions and this pops when the chapter ends. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. By now the big robbery systems are open, so the cleanup trophies tied to bank vaults and armored trucks become available.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish Chapter 4's main missions and this pops when the chapter ends. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Finishing the story also unlocks the 100% Completion checklist and free-roam, which is where the long second stage of the platinum hunt begins.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks. It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 to the end; the trophy is automatic story progress. It cannot be missed. There are no gold-medal objectives on story missions, so just finish the mission however you like.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Play the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 to the end; the trophy is automatic story progress. It cannot be missed. There are no gold-medal objectives on story missions, so just finish the mission however you like.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Heist missions are story-gated, so there is no way to do this one early or skip it.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Heist missions are story-gated, so there is no way to do this one early or skip it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the end of the mission. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. Keep playing the main path and it will come to you.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the end of the mission. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. Keep playing the main path and it will come to you.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. No special objective is needed — finishing the mission is enough.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed. No special objective is needed — finishing the mission is enough.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. The airport setting here is a good preview of the free-roam plane trophy at VCIA later.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. The airport setting here is a good preview of the free-roam plane trophy at VCIA later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. This is one of the last big story missions, so the endgame and free-roam cleanup follow soon after.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed. This is one of the last big story missions, so the endgame and free-roam cleanup follow soon after.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist (Touchpad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) after finishing the story and work through it. The name overstates it: both guides agree you only need roughly 60% of the game's true content — for example any 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 15 of 18 card sets, and any 70 of 80 challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable, so this is a long grind, not a race.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Open the 100% Completion checklist (Touchpad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) after finishing the story and work through it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Stunts come in four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely. Both guides agree under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track them on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, or under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race of some kind, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. You will meet most of them naturally through the story and the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own — if one is missing, open the map's Activities filter (the blue dumbbell icon) and go try the one you have not done.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race of some kind, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two ranges both guides name: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Find them on the map under Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track progress the same way. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, so work through them as they open up.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two ranges both guides name: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; there are 42 drone races in total across them, and some charge an entry fee. Find the locations on the map under Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. You only need one win per location, not every race at each spot, so move on as soon as a location is ticked off.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; there are 42 drone races in total across them, and some charge an entry fee. Find the locations on the map under Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race does not count, each win has to be at a new location. Track them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, then Racing. Most race spots let you hire a car, and if you bring your own, mind its rating; buying upgrades at Mod Shops raises it. Pick the short, easy races first and save the hard ones for later.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race does not count, each win has to be at a new location. Track them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, then Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he will text you about a fishing challenge: catch a parrotfish over 2 kg at the marked spot west of Key Lento. Fish in the marked area from a boat with a rod until you land one big enough. You can hijack a boat nearby if you do not own one yet.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he will text you about a fishing challenge: catch a parrotfish over 2 kg at the marked spot west of Key Lento.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge inside it, so pick the one you enjoy most.
trophies.guide_short: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-quest storyline, which is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. The quests run through the Cellerica initiation chain and end with the warehouse meet. All of Andy's quests stay available after the story, so nothing here can be missed — just follow the markers when they appear.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish Andy's five-quest storyline, which is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. The quests run through the Cellerica initiation chain and end with the warehouse meet.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's treasure-diving quests: after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls you, then marks shipwreck sites on the map and you dive for the treasure with a metal detector and bring it back to his shop in Key Lento. There are seven shipwrecks in total across his quest sets. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story but comes back later, so this is not missable — track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Work through Kenton's treasure-diving quests: after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls you, then marks shipwreck sites on the map and you dive for the treasure with a metal detector and bring it back to his shop in Key Lento.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's five quests, starting at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The chain runs through the mud club jobs and ends with Hometown Heroes. All five stay available after the story, so this cannot be missed — do them whenever the markers show up.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete Billy's five quests, starting at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The chain runs through the mud club jobs and ends with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands in the open world — but note that not every side quest counts: the guides agree the questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Strands that do count include Kirk's skunk-ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street races and Pilot Pete's deliveries. Strangers stay available after the story, so mop these up in the cleanup stage and watch the trophy tracker to see your count rise.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete 8 stranger mission strands in the open world — but note that not every side quest counts: the guides agree the questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you get the Key Cloner and deliver a Zorrusso to Randy, who then hands you a list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. The list stays open after the story, so it cannot be missed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish Randy's Wish List: after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you get the Key Cloner and deliver a Zorrusso to Randy, who then hands you a list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's Jason-only questline, which starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy the Kitty Litter synthetic labs marked around Vice City, and once enough are gone Tyrone gives you the Spin On This mission to shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story, so this cannot be missed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Finish Tyrone's Jason-only questline, starting after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy the Kitty Litter synthetic labs around Vice City, then Tyrone gives you the Spin On This mission to shut the labs down.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and read the warning first, because this is the game's only potentially missable trophy. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is gone forever once you leave Chapter 1. Both guides flag the same catch: it is still unconfirmed whether that first meditation is actually required for the trophy, so do it anyway to be safe. The other spots can be done with either character (each counts double if both meditate there), and you cannot finish the last ones until both characters can play together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and read the warning first, because this is the game's only potentially missable trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Do Bret Vogel's hunting quests, which start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 when Bret texts Jason (Jason-only) and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots on the map and asks you to bring him the animals he requests. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest; a clean one-shot kill keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. The questline stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Do Bret Vogel's hunting quests, which start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 when Bret texts Jason (Jason-only) and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets found around Leonida. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this silver pops early on the way to that bigger goal. Track your sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards — and note that cards you sell at pawn shops still count toward your progress, so selling duplicates is safe.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets found around Leonida. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this silver pops early on the way to that bigger goal.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1 while looking at a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or No Flusher tag). There are far more than 100 in the world — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the tags — so just scan whatever you pass. Track the count under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1 while looking at a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or No Flusher tag).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. View them all under Progress, then Challenges, with a checkmark showing which are done. Many complete naturally while you chase other trophies, so leave the hard ones: with 30 to spare for the checklist and 10 to spare for this trophy, pick the easiest ones left.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. View them all under Progress, then Challenges, with a checkmark showing which are done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone completely. You can only do this after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle). The easiest escape both guides point to is a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. The trophy pops when you leave the heat zone, not just the flashing search area — and it usually comes free while robbing the big bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone completely. You can only do this after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner with you, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — you must stay wanted the whole time, in the flashing red/blue state rather than the full red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and loot a couple of items in each shop (a safe in the back room helps it count). The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are a good run once they open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: With your partner with you, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — you must stay wanted the whole time, in the flashing red/blue state rather than the full red heat level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles; scanning one with the WAiNK app is enough, you do not have to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles in the game and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this comes naturally early in that grind. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Discover 100 different vehicles; scanning one with the WAiNK app is enough, you do not have to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming), which slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Eat or drink first to buff focus, and use Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window; a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556 helps. Line up five enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and go for it — and note it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up as you play (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all help), so this gets easier late in the game.
trophies.guide_short: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming), which slows time and drains the purple focus bar.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the ones on the open airfield do not count, it must be connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the ones on the open airfield do not count, it must be connected to a boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island base on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so bring armor and a fast approach vehicle.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island base on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand in the south of the base.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, which unlocks jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors. Then enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun (never kick the door), find the safe code on a note in the back room, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, which unlocks jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape; the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this silver pops on the way. It starts with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. Note: the official list grades this silver; one of the guides we checked lists it as bronze, and the official grade wins.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape; the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this silver pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The simplest route is the same Chapter 4 mission as the bank vaults — tailing the truck to a bank counts as robbing it. Earlier, you can also stop a truck on the road near a bank, block it, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done). The trophy only pops after you have escaped, so keep driving until the heat clears.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The simplest route is the same Chapter 4 mission as the bank vaults — tailing the truck to a bank counts as robbing it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible. Do this late, once you have a plane and the full map is open, and combine it with the stunt and vehicle-scanning grinds so the flights do double duty.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; there are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops early in that grind. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs, and finish whichever gang is still at zero.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; there are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops early in that grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy — a quick, cheap one to tick off during cleanup. It is a small nod to the series' past, and it pops as soon as you finish the drink.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy — a quick, cheap one to tick off during cleanup.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, to get into the car. Only this specific blue Banshee counts — a reference to the Banshee from GTA III — and the pop comes slightly delayed, after you drive away down the street.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, to get into the car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs bought at an Ammu-Nation. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but this is not missable: if you leave anything behind, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east corner, and safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only becomes possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between the two. Work out at fitness clubs (filter the map by Activities) and always bring your partner along — while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then each character's Strength stat. You can also work out at home after the story.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only becomes possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between the two.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the running count is visible by selecting this trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy robberies, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho, and keep pushing and you can hit Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight. Almost every robbery and fight counts, so this usually finishes itself while you chase the other trophies.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the running count is visible by selecting this trophy in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy is still unconfirmed: the best current lead, from the guide we checked, is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way — at its Vice City location in Little Cuba. Treat this one as a watch item: try revisiting the Payday Loans store after the story and robbing it a second time, and check community reports if it does not pop. We flag it as unconfirmed rather than guessing a method, because no source we checked has a verified unlock yet.
trophies.guide_short: Still unconfirmed: the best current lead is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way — at its Vice City location in Little Cuba.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — the spawn is slightly random, so drive away and come back if it is not there. When the car is there, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky, approach the UFO, and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy.
trophies.guide_short: Complete the UFO easter egg: go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with a melee attack (Square) within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach are the place to do it: keep moving through the crowd and kick as you pass people. The timer starts with the first kick, so line up a busy stretch before you begin.
trophies.guide_short: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with a melee attack (Square) within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach are the place to do it: keep moving through the crowd and kick as you pass people.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through a fence — the amount adds up across robberies, it does not have to be delivered at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder the bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, take the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most), and repeat. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one robbery, so this finishes naturally during the vault grind.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through a fence — the amount adds up across robberies, it does not have to be delivered at once.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative across the whole game, so normal play already counts toward it. The fastest way to close the gap is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. Find shops on the map under Touchpad, then Style. You will almost certainly pass $100,000 while gearing up for the other trophies anyway.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative across the whole game, so normal play already counts toward it. The fastest way to close the gap is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total — through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The garages are Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800). Each adds parking spots you need for registering vehicles, and robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to earn the cash. The four story garages do not count.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total — through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Buy garages first (see Little Boxes), because each one adds the parking spots you need to register more vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register — early on he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep it cheap.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com)
trophies.guide_short: Register 10 different vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses.
